text:
Maya Henderson: quick sync — launching the Partner Catalyst onboarding next week, want to confirm lab access + hardware handoff for integrators :rocket:
Liam Ortiz: do we have a definitive list of SI accounts that need GPU sandbox access? I can provision today if so
Ravi Patel: list is in the confluence page, but we should gate by certification cohort. i'll paste the cohort IDs in a sec
Sofia Nguyen: heads-up — a couple of integrators will want marketplace listing guidance (billing + SKUs). can we include a 15m session? :calendar:
Maya Henderson: yes, include marketplace + hw sync. agenda draft: 1) intro + expectations 2) lab access & VPN 3) HW compatibility + test images 4) certification steps 5) go-to-market checklist
Liam Ortiz: schedule snippet ok. suggested times: Tue 09:00 PT or Wed 16:00 PT. which works for EU integrators?
Ravi Patel: Tue 09:00 PT favours APAC less. Wed 16:00 PT hits EMEA/APAC decently. let's pick Wed and record
Sofia Nguyen: +1 Wed 16:00 PT. i'll prep a short deck on marketplace onboarding (15 slides) and sample SKU mapping
Maya Henderson: can someone add the infra playbook link to the invite? OnboardingBot should auto-provision VPN creds after RSVP
OnboardingBot: NOTE: automatic VPN credential generation will run 24h before the session for RSVP'd accounts. See https://confluence.redwood.ai/partner-catalyst/onboard (access: partners.md)
Ravi Patel: raw schedule block (paste for invite):
```
Wed 16:00 PT — Partner Catalyst Integrator Launch (90m)
16:00-16:10 — Welcome + expectations
16:10-16:30 — Lab access & VPN walkthrough (Liam)
16:30-17:00 — Hardware compat + test images (Sofia)
17:00-17:20 — Certification path & evals (Ravi)
17:20-17:45 — Marketplace listing + GTM checklist (Maya)
17:45-17:30 — Q&A + next steps
```
Sofia Nguyen: tiny note — test images for A100/RTX series are separate buckets. i'll add CLI snippet for mounting test datasets
Liam Ortiz: CLI snippet ok. we'll need to open ports 8443 and 10250 on the sandbox security group for the onboarding lab
Maya Henderson: action items: (1) Liam: VPN + security group changes (2) Sofia: test images + SKU mapping (3) Ravi: cert cohort emails + eval link (4) Maya: invite + recording + confluence update
Ravi Patel: i'll draft the certification email and a short checklist for integrators (expected time: 2hrs). will share before EOD
Liam Ortiz: started the security ticket: INFRA-4721. linking it in the invite.
Maya Henderson: perfect. everyone, please react with :thumbsup: when done with your item so I can close the prep list
Sofia Nguyen: :thumbsup:
Liam Ortiz: :thumbsup:
Ravi Patel: :thumbsup:
OnboardingBot: Reminder scheduled: 24h pre-meeting provisioning + 4h pre-meeting access check.
Maya Henderson: thanks team — this will make the SI onboarding much smoother. recording + post-session playbook will become canonical.
